product.title: Osho. Intimitatea. Încrederea în sine și în celălalt
product.description: Învăţăturile lui Osho, unul dintre cei mai cunoscuţi lideri spirituali ai secolului XX, răstoarnă tiparele clasice de gândire, provocându-ne la o permanentă punere sub semnul întrebării a certitudinilor şi la un proces de conştientizare de sine. Cărţile din seria „Incursiune într-un nou mod de viaţă“ prezintă viziunea acestuia privind cele mai importante probleme pe care şi le pun oamenii interesaţi de ştiinţa transformării de sine şi de o spiritualitate adaptată la provocările cotidiene ale vieţii contemporane. „Intimitatea înseamnă să te expui în faţa unui străin – şi toţi suntem străini; nimeni nu cunoaşte pe nimeni. Suntem străini chiar şi pentru noi înşine, pentru că nu ştim cine suntem. Intimitatea te apropie de un străin. Trebuie să renunţi la toate apărările; numai atunci intimitatea e cu putinţă. Iar teama îţi spune că în prezenţa unui străin e mai sigur să păstrezi puţină distanţă, puţină apărare, pentru că acel străin ar putea să profite de slăbiciunea ta, de fragilitatea ta, de vulnerabilitatea ta.“ OSHO

This work is more than just philosophy; it's an active process of self-awareness designed to help you navigate the complexities of modern life and build authentic relationships.

At its heart, Osho defines intimacy as vulnerabilityâit is about exposure before another person, who is inherently a stranger. According to the teachings: "Intimacy means exposing yourself in front of a strangerâand we are all strangers; nobody knows anybody. We are even strangers to ourselves, because we don't know who we are."

True connection requires shedding all defenses. As Osho elaborates, **"To achieve intimacy, you must renounce all your protections. Only then is true intimacy possible."** This powerful concept addresses the universal fear that maintaining emotional distance or building protective walls might be safer than risking genuine closeness with another person.

## Transform Your Relationships and Self-Perception

If you are interested in mastering self-discovery and enhancing your capacity for deep, meaningful relationships, this volume provides timeless guidance. The book encourages readers to look inward, recognizing that true confidenceâboth internal self-confidence and trust in othersâstems from acknowledging our shared vulnerability.

*   **Challenge Assumptions:** Learn how Osho's perspective helps you break free from limiting thought patterns.
*   **Embrace Vulnerability:** Understand why letting go of emotional defenses is the prerequisite for profound intimacy.
*   **Modern Spirituality:** Gain tools to integrate spiritual wisdom into the daily routines and pressures of modern life.

By engaging with these teachings, readers gain a clearer understanding of who they are when the protective masks come off, allowing them to build both self-confidence and genuine connection with others.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for beginners in spiritual practice?**
A: Yes. While Osho's concepts can be profound, the series aims to provide actionable insights into contemporary living, making it accessible for those beginning their journey of self-discovery and understanding modern spirituality.

**Q: Does "Intimacy" mean romantic relationships only?**
